title: Curcumin suppresses colorectal cancer by induction of ferroptosis via regulation of p53 and solute carrier family 7 member 11/glutathione/glutathione peroxidase 4 signaling axis.
authors: Ming, Tianqi; Lei, Jiarong; Peng, Yuhui; Wang, Minmin; Liang, Yuanjing; Tang, Shun; Tao, Qiu; Wang, Muqing; Tang, Xiaomeng; He, Ziyu; Liu, Xiaohong; Xu, Haibo
one_liner_zh: 该文研究姜黄素通过p53和SLC7A11/GPX4轴诱导结直肠癌铁死亡，仅含分子对接预测，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Driven by iron-dependent lipid peroxidation, ferroptosis is regulated by p53 and solute carrier family 7 member 11 (SLC7A11)/glutathione/glutathione peroxidase 4 (GPX4) axis in colorectal cancer (CRC). This study aimed to investigate the influence of curcumin (CUR) on ferroptosis in CRC. The efficacies of CUR on the malignant phenotype of CRC cells were determined by 3-(4,5-dimethylthiazol-2-yl)-2,5-diphenyl tetrazolium bromide, wound healing, and clonogenic assays. The effects of CUR on ferroptosis of CRC cells were evaluated by transmission electron microscopy, lactate dehydrogenase release assay, Fe(2+) staining, and analyses of reactive oxygen species, lipid peroxide, malondialdehyde, and glutathione levels. CUR's targets in ferroptosis were predicted by network pharmacological study and molecular docking. With SW620 xenograft tumors, the efficacy of CUR on CRC was investigated, and the effects of CUR on ferroptosis were assessed by detection of Fe(2+), malondialdehyde, and glutathione levels. The effects of CUR on expressions of p53, SLC7A11, and GPX4 in CRC cells and tumors were analyzed by quantitative reverse transcription-polymerase chain reaction, western blotting, and immunohistochemistry. CUR suppressed the proliferation, migration, and clonogenesis of CRC cells and xenograft tumor growth by causing ferroptosis, with enhanced lactate dehydrogenase release and Fe(2+), reactive oxygen species, lipid peroxide, and malondialdehyde levels, but attenuated glutathione level in CRC. In silico study indicated that CUR may bind p53, SLC7A11, and GPX4, consolidated by that CUR heightened p53 but attenuated SLC7A11 and GPX4 mRNA and protein levels in CRC. CUR may exert an inhibitory effect on CRC by inducing ferroptosis via regulation of p53 and SLC7A11/glutathione/GPX4 axis.
abstract_zh: 在铁依赖性脂质过氧化的驱动下，铁死亡 (ferroptosis) 在结直肠癌 (colorectal cancer, CRC) 中受p53和溶质载体家族7成员11 (solute carrier family 7 member 11, SLC7A11)/谷胱甘肽/谷胱甘肽过氧化物酶4 (glutathione peroxidase 4, GPX4) 轴的调控。本研究旨在探讨姜黄素 (curcumin, CUR) 对CRC中铁死亡的影响。通过3-(4,5-二甲基噻唑-2-基)-2,5-二苯基四唑溴化物、伤口愈合和克隆形成实验测定CUR对CRC细胞恶性表型的功效。通过透射电子显微镜、乳酸脱氢酶释放实验、Fe(2+)染色以及活性氧、脂质过氧化物、丙二醛和谷胱甘肽水平分析评估CUR对CRC细胞铁死亡的影响。通过网络药理学研究和分子对接预测CUR在铁死亡中的靶点。利用SW620异种移植肿瘤，研究CUR对CRC的功效，并通过检测Fe(2+)、丙二醛和谷胱甘肽水平评估CUR对铁死亡的影响。通过定量逆转录聚合酶链反应、蛋白质印迹和免疫组织化学分析CUR对CRC细胞和肿瘤中p53、SLC7A11和GPX4表达的影响。CUR通过引起铁死亡抑制CRC细胞的增殖、迁移和克隆形成以及异种移植肿瘤生长，表现为乳酸脱氢酶释放和Fe(2+)、活性氧、脂质过氧化物和丙二醛水平升高，但CRC中谷胱甘肽水平降低。计算机模拟研究表明，CUR可能结合p53、SLC7A11和GPX4，并通过CUR提高p53但降低CRC中SLC7A11和GPX4的mRNA和蛋白水平得到证实。CUR可能通过调控p53和SLC7A11/谷胱甘肽/GPX4轴诱导铁死亡，从而对CRC发挥抑制作用。
